text_block_list.text:
I brought the injured Believe
to the nurse's office.
choice_data_list: That should take care of the treatment... and done.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for troubling you.
However...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Injuries can't be completely avoided, can they?
Rather than an accident, it's more like—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I think it's something you simply have to live with.
After all, no craftsman works without scratches on their hands.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...So, with that in mind, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I do not believe one should use an injury of this degree
as an excuse to miss work.
choice_data_list: Resting is part of the job, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......
I've heard those words many times before.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Like a grandmother gently admonishing a grandfather
who refuses to take a day off work no matter what happens.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Even my stubborn grandad who never listens to anyone
can never say no to grandma..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: She must believe in it that much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
...I think I'll get some rest as well.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
If only we can manage to nurse the injury while going about our daily routine...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "Trying to favor it, it seems I ended up twisting the other side instead..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You're covered in bruises and exhausted... It might take
a little time to fully recover from this.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, it seems like nothing's wrong.
There's almost no pain, and my balance is fine.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It looks like we don't have to worry about the injury anymore.
Let's proceed as usual.
